title: Mismagius Witch Hut and Bell Tower
sourceTitle: I Built an Insane WITCH HUT for MISMAGIUS! 🔮 Pokopia Build
creator: zoibean
summary: A whimsical Mismagius witch hut with a tall looping purple staircase, antique wood facade, flower-covered garden, glowing mushroom lights, and a separate cobblestone bell tower.
publicNotes:
## Build Notes

This Mismagius witch hut turns a compact antique-style house into a dramatic fantasy landmark. A looping purple staircase climbs above the roofline, with glowing mushroom lights and flowers placed along the ascent. The garden path, dense evergreens, and separate cobblestone bell tower give the build a layered storybook silhouette.

The creator includes two recommended-item slides with the main structural materials, making the house especially approachable to recreate.
automationNotes: Automated YouTube player capture returned invalid shell frames, so the curator supplied a wide hero screenshot, a closer exterior detail, and two recommended-item slides.
The flower quantities at the top of the first recommended-item slide are visible but their exact catalog names should be confirmed before adding them.
